+#include "csv_parser.h"
+#include <limits.h>
+
+int parse_csv_records(int record_count, int* field_sizes, char** csv_data, char** parsed_buffer) {
+    /* Validate input parameters */
+    if (record_count <= 0 || field_sizes == NULL || csv_data == NULL || parsed_buffer == NULL) {
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    if (csv_data[0] == NULL) {
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    /* Determine number of fields by counting commas in the first record */
+    int num_fields = 1;
+    for (const char* p = csv_data[0]; *p != '\0'; p++) {
+        if (*p == ',') {
+            num_fields++;
+        }
+    }
+
+    /* Calculate the size of one record (sum of all field sizes) */
+    int record_size = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < num_fields; i++) {
+        if (field_sizes[i] <= 0) {
+            return -1;
+        }
+        record_size += field_sizes[i];
+    }
+
+    /* Overflow check for total buffer size */
+    if (record_count > INT_MAX / record_size) {
+        return -1;
+    }
+    size_t total_size = (size_t)record_count * (size_t)record_size;
+
+    /* Allocate and zero-initialize the buffer */
+    char* buffer = (char*)malloc(total_size);
+    if (buffer == NULL) {
+        return -1;
+    }
+    memset(buffer, 0, total_size);
+
+    /* Parse each CSV record into the buffer */
+    for (int r = 0; r < record_count; r++) {
+        if (csv_data[r] == NULL) {
+            free(buffer);
+            return -1;
+        }
+
+        char* record_start = buffer + (size_t)r * (size_t)record_size;
+        int offset = 0;
+        const char* src = csv_data[r];
+
+        for (int f = 0; f < num_fields; f++) {
+            int field_size = field_sizes[f];
+            const char* field_start = src;
+
+            /* Find the end of the current field (comma or end of string) */
+            while (*src != '\0' && *src != ',') {
+                src++;
+            }
+
+            int field_len = (int)(src - field_start);
+            /* Copy at most field_size - 1 bytes to ensure null termination */
+            int copy_len = field_len < (field_size - 1) ? field_len : (field_size - 1);
+
+            if (copy_len > 0) {
+                memcpy(record_start + offset, field_start, (size_t)copy_len);
+            }
+            offset += field_size;
+
+            /* Skip the comma separator */
+            if (*src == ',') {
+                src++;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    *parsed_buffer = buffer;
+    return 0;
+}
